mapper.select: SELECT dashboard_date AS date, SUM(user_count) AS userCount, SUM(notice_count) AS noticeCount, SUM(operation_count) AS operationCount FROM ( SELECT DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y-%m-%d') AS dashboard_date, COUNT(*) AS user_count, 0 AS notice_count, 0 AS operation_count FROM sys_user WHERE del_flag = '0' AND create_time >= #{startTime} AND create_time < #{endTime} GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y-%m-%d') UNION ALL SELECT DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y-%m-%d') AS dashboard_date, 0 AS user_count, COUNT(*) AS notice_count, 0 AS operation_count FROM sys_notice WHERE status = '0' AND create_time >= #{startTime} AND create_time < #{endTime} GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y-%m-%d') UNION ALL SELECT DATE_FORMAT(oper_time, '%Y-%m-%d') AS dashboard_date, 0 AS user_count, 0 AS notice_count, COUNT(*) AS operation_count FROM sys_oper_log WHERE oper_time >= #{startTime} AND oper_time < #{endTime} GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(oper_time, '%Y-%m-%d') ) dashboard_trend GROUP BY dashboard_date ORDER BY dashboard_date
SELECT status AS code, COUNT(*) AS count FROM sys_user WHERE del_flag = '0' GROUP BY status ORDER BY status
